id: title:dmarticus:open a task s pull request from the chat menu

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a GitHub PR URL button to the task execution results view, allowing users to inspect the implementation of a specific task run.
review.reason: The change adds a conditional button to display a GitHub pull request URL associated with a task's latest run, provided the URL passes a safety check. This is a localized UI enhancement for the task execution workflow.
review.uncertainty: The score is assigned based solely on the observed addition of a UI button. No evidence exists regarding the actual benefit of this button, the frequency of its use, or whether the underlying GitHub integration is widely adopted. The score does not account for potential downstream value or unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single PR. No relationship between PRs is established.

observations.behavior: Adds a conditional button to open a GitHub pull request URL.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows a PostHog user to open a GitHub PR URL associated with a task's latest run output, provided the URL passes a shared GitHub URL safety check.
